$comment: Template for one docs-effectiveness eval case (T5.1). Copy to eval-seeds/<scenario_id>.json; every field is required.
situation: 2-6 sentences a competent newcomer could act on; no outcome presupposed
required_decision: the one decision the docs must produce
required_check: the check the docs must name (check_id from the rule-check matrix)
owning_doc: the single document that must own this rule
required_unknowns: facts the docs do not establish and the answer must not invent
forbidden_action: actions that make the answer wrong even if the decision is right

example.situation: A developer adds a reviewed Concept node to the derived store, then runs the nightly metadata sync to pick up new Zotero items. The next morning the Concept node is gone.
example.required_decision: The sync must not delete extraction or review state; scope it to owned metadata or isolate extraction in a separate store.
required_unknowns: whether HawDB supports the additive ALTER path
whether the derived store has a schema version
forbidden_action: accepting the data loss because the metadata is canonical
re-running extraction to repopulate without a count guard
